name: Verizon (postpaid mobile)
why: Largest U.S. wireless carrier (~147M connections per catalog); top of the category ranking.

name: T-Mobile (postpaid)
why: Second-largest national carrier; distinct T-Life / My T-Mobile billing site.

name: AT&T Wireless (postpaid)
why: Third national carrier (~121M connections per catalog); myAT&T billing.

name: Cricket Wireless
why: Largest prepaid brand on AT&T's network; its own cricketwireless.com Pay Bill / Quick Pay site.

name: Metro by T-Mobile
why: Largest prepaid brand on T-Mobile's network; separate metrobyt-mobile.com account and Express Pay.

name: Boost Mobile
why: Fourth facilities-based national brand (~7.5M customers per catalog); boostmobile.com account.

name: Xfinity Mobile
why: Largest cable MVNO; Xfinity Mobile bill is separate from other Xfinity services.

name: Spectrum Mobile
why: Second-largest cable MVNO; separate Spectrum Mobile billing with mandatory Auto Pay.

name: Visible (by Verizon)
why: Major app/online-only prepaid brand with its own visible.com account (distinct from Verizon postpaid billing).

name: Google Fi Wireless
why: Well-known national MVNO billed through fi.google.com; chosen over Consumer Cellular, whose help pages sit behind a bot check and could not be researched.
